# Pull Request Template

## Description
Please describe the changes you made and the motivation for this pull request.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Other (please describe)

## Checklist
- [ ] I have read the CONTRIBUTING guide
- [ ] I have tested my changes locally
- [ ] I have added appropriate documentation
- [ ] I have added appropriate error handling
- [ ] I have not introduced new dependencies (or documented them)

## Screenshots/Videos
If applicable, add screenshots or videos demonstrating the fix or feature.

## Checklist for Maintainers
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Code follows project style guidelines
- [ ] Documentation is updated
- [ ] No breaking changes (or documented)
